title.narrative: Support to the ratification of Addis-Convention and academic mobility

description.narrative: Like African continent Ethiopia is a country of opportunity, with the second youngest population in Africa, growing innovation and rising economic power. Strengthening and connecting Ethiopian higher education systems and institutions is key to widening opportunities and advancing socio-economic development. Within the framework of the Flagship Campus Africa and in partnership with AUC, AAU, AUF and Global Obreal UNESCO Liaison Office will and the MoE will contribute to the implementation of Campus Africa. UNESCO will support Ethiopia to ratify and implement the Addis Recognition Convention, to strengthen academic recognition, mobility and inter-university cooperation among African countries. The capacity building and advocacy will be provided to support the ratification of the Global Convention on the recognition of qualification concerning higher education in Ethiopia.
